title: Catalog previews still miss 2 s for 40 cards; doc pages' tab bar wraps at 1200

owner_note.text: Live previews can't load 40 cards in 2 s. I shipped a queue that shows the first preview in 0.9 s instead of 8.3 s; 40 still take about 10 s. The full fix is a still picture per card, and it waits on one choice: commit those pictures to the repo (about 3.4 MB) or make them at build time (catalog/doc/next.md). Separately, the tab bar on doc pages (Object, the surfaces page) wraps to 2 rows at 1200 px. That bar belongs to ext/Doc, outside this task, so I left it.
